decision.question: Should we declare Feb 22-28 a 'Ship Week' — zero new documents, only outbound actions with daily targets?
decision.recommendation: Yes. The portfolio has 80+ strategy docs and zero outbound activity. The preparation phase must end. A structured Ship Week with daily accountability (messages sent, calls booked) breaks the planning loop.
evidence: Daily plans Feb 6-8 are identical — same tasks, no progress markers
Feb 18 timeline review confirms: no outreach sent, no investor calls, no revenue
OttoGen has 15+ docs ready (DMs, brand, targets, packages) but 0 clients contacted
IAM has 50 prospects listed but 0 emails sent
ZenithCred has full deck + 30 investor targets but 0 meetings scheduled
February roadmap target was €2-5K revenue — will hit €0

options.label: Ship Week
options.description: Feb 22-28: daily outbound targets. Mon: 10 OttoGen DMs. Tue: 5 IAM emails. Wed: 3 investor emails. Thu-Fri: follow-ups + Chimera repo publish. No new docs.

options.label: Gradual ramp
options.description: Continue current pace, start outreach in March. Risk: March targets also slip.

options.label: Hire help
options.description: Outsource cold outreach to a VA/freelancer. Cost: €200-500/month. Frees Otto for calls/delivery.
